## Bindable type

A value that can be bound to a placeholder in a prepared statement.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Bindable = string | number | boolean | Date | null | undefined;
```

## Remarks

`undefined` is accepted and normalised to `NULL` by every driver, so an optional field can be passed straight through without a guard.
